verdict.rationale: Kit's documented sending capability is broadcast/marketing email to subscriber segments and tags (kit-docs-1, kit-docs-2, kit-docs-43), with no mention of a separate transactional-sending pathway, dedicated templates, or reputation isolation that would let a receipt bypass marketing suppression/unsubscribe rules. The axis is fair to ask of any email-sending platform, but no evidence shows Kit offers transactional email at all.
